arabic text: AKBER TUJE KASAM HAI WAAPAS ZAROOR AANA\nEK BAAR AAKE APNI MAADAR KO DEKH JAANA\nAKBER TUJE KASAM HAI WAAPAS ZAROOR AANA
english translation text: AKBER, PROMISE ME THAT YOU WILL RETURN (FROM THE BATTLEFIELD)\nJUST ONCE, COME TO SEE YOUR MOTHER\nAKBER, PROMISE ME THAT YOU WILL RETURN (FROM THE BATTLEFIELD)

arabic text: MAA JAANTI HAI BETA MARNE KO JAA RAHA HAI\nAUR BAAP KEH RAHA AANSU NAHI BAHANA
english translation text: YOUR MOTHER KNOWS THAT HER SON\nIS GOING TO DIE\nAND YOUR FATHER SAYS 'DO NOT SHED TEARS.'

arabic text: AKBER TUJE KASAM HAI WAAPAS ZAROOR AANA
english translation text: AKBER, PROMISE ME THAT YOU WILL RETURN (FROM THE BATTLEFIELD)

arabic text: ZAINAB NAI TUJHKO BETA, ATTHARA SAAL PAALA\nWOH CHAAHTI HAI BETA, DULHA TUJHE BANANA
english translation text: O’ SON, ZAINAB RAISED YOU FOR EIGHTEEN YEARS,\nO’ SON, SHE WISHES TO SEE YOU AS A GROOM.

arabic text: QATIL BADHA JO AAGE, KEHNE LAGI JAWANI\nHUM SHAKL-E-MUSTAFA HAI, BARCHI NAHI LAGANA
english translation text: AS THE SLAYER STEPPED FORWARD, THE YOUTH SAID:\n'HE RESEMBLES THE PROPHET, STRIKE NOT THE SPEAR'.

arabic text: DAUDE HUSSAIN FAURAN, THAME HUE JIGAR KO\nKEHTE HUE AYE BETA, MUSHKIL HAI MERA AANA
english translation text: HUSSAIN RUSHED FORTH, HAND UPON HEART\nSAYING: 'O’ MY SON, IT’S HARD FOR ME TO COME (TO YOUR CORPSE)'

arabic text: PONCHE KHAREEB JIS DAM PHIR GIR PADE ZAMEEN PAR\nAANDHAIR THA NAZAR MAI, SHABBIR KO ZAMANA
english translation text: HE (IMAM) CAME NEAR (THE CORPSE) AND FELL TO THE GROUND\nTHE WORLD TURNED DARK IN SHABBIR’S EYES

arabic text: SHEH SE NA UTH SAKI JAB, KADYAL JAWAN KI MAYYIT\nBACHOON KE SAATH MILKAR, LAASHA PADA UTHANA
english translation text: WHEN THE IMAM WAS UNABLE TO CARRY THE BUDDING YOUTH’S CORPSE\nTOGETHER WITH SOME CHILDREN HE HAD TO CARRY THE CORPSE

arabic text: LAASHE KO RAKH KEH BOLE, LAILA SE YE SHEH-E-DEEN\nBETE KI AAKE APNI, MANNAT ZARA BADHANA
english translation text: LAYING THE CORPSE BEFORE HER, SAID THE KING OF RELIGION TO LAILA\nCOME FULFIL YOUR SON’S PLEDGE

arabic text: AKBER TUJHE KASAM HAI WAAPAS ZAROOR AANA\nEK BAAR AAKE APNI MAADAR KO DEKH JAANA
english translation text: AKBER, PROMISE ME THAT YOU WILL RETURN (FROM THE BATTLEFIELD)\nJUST ONCE, COME TO SEE YOUR MOTHER
